Title: Geist-reiches Gesang-Buch, den Kern alter und neuer Lieder, wie auch die Noten der unbekannten Melodeyen und dazu gehörige nützliche Register in sich haltend; zum sechzehenten mal herausgegeben
Creator: Johann Anastasius Freylinghausen (1670-1739), editor; hymns by Freylinghausen, Francke, Spener, Richter, Schade and others
Publisher: Halle: in Verlegung des Waysenhauses
Publication Date: 1730
Rights: Public Domain (published 1730, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights field reads "http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/")
Language: deu
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_sYZFAAAAcAAJ (https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_sYZFAAAAcAAJ), the item's own bub_gb_sYZFAAAAcAAJ_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Bavarian State Library; host metadata date: 1730. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-16. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: a1837e7d63ebe831f8df1e2f7afbd5fd8c03e81dcf89c2596910530c149c3846.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. A single 'Digitized by Google' line precedes the title page and is left in place. Fraktur OCR with f/long-s confusion; stanzas numbered and legible.
Content note: The Halle hymnbook in its sixteenth edition, the movement's sung voice, carried to Pennsylvania and Herrnhut. The 1706 third edition (bub_gb_rOgUAAAAQAAJ) was verified and not vendored. No PD English of the book as such.
